AI-Powered Schema Mapping & SQL Generation Platform -Python · FastAPI · LangChain · GPT-4omini · DuckDB · Docker · Azure · Terraform
Reduced data schema mapping turnaround from weeks to under 5 minutes by engineering a fullstack LLM-powered platform with 10+ intelligent matching strategies (semantic similarity, NLP, abbreviation, domain-specific) and confidence scoring.
Built a natural language-to-SQL engine enabling non-technical users to query complex datasets without writing SQL, backed by a human-in-the-loop approval and refinement workflow for mapping accuracy.
Deployed as containerized microservice on Azure (ACR + App Service) using Terraform IaC; features JWT auth, multi-session management, background task processing, multi-file uploads, multi-sheet merging, and UNION query generation.
AI-Powered RFP Response Automation System -Python · FastAPI · React/TypeScript · LangGraph ·
GPT-4o · Qdrant · Mem0 · Docker
Reduced enterprise RFP response time from days to minutes by developing a LangGraph-based agentic workflow with a 5-node state machine for end-to-end question extraction, context retrieval, and professional answer generation.
Implemented RAG using Qdrant vector database and Mem0 persistent memory; designed a continuous learning loop achieving 80-90% answer reuse on future RFPs.
Built a React/TypeScript frontend with real-time progress tracking, inline AI-assisted editing, and PDF export; integrated multi-format document parsing and semantic search.
Inferalytics - Mathematical Optimization & Forecasting SaaS Platform -React 18 · TypeScript · Zu stand · TanStack Query · Tailwind CSS · FastAPI · Anthropic Claude API · SSE · Clerk · Recharts · scikit-lear n · XGBoost · PyTorch
Architected and delivered a full-stack AI decision-formation platform from the ground up. Built a conversational AI interface where Claude drives the entire user workflow - from understanding the decision objective through natural language, to requesting data uploads, constructing a live world model, and triggering Newton-Raphson optimisations and Holt-Winters forecasts autonomously.
Designed a Figma-style interactive canvas (React/TypeScript) where uploaded data auto-converges into vectorised dimension cards with live relationship connectors, and results materialise as persistent canvas objects.
Engineered the AI action-dispatch architecture on FastAPI - allowing Claude to emit structured action blocks that trigger backend computations and update the frontend in real time via SSE streaming. Integrated Clerk authentication with a full JWT middleware rewire on the existing Python backend.
Delivered a scenario comparison workspace enabling side-by-side trade-off analysis across multiple forecast runs. Scoped and authored a two-phase technical proposal covering platform delivery and a subsequent ML intelligence layer (custom forecasting models, multi-objective optimisation, SHAP-based feature importance, and domain fine-tuning).
Automated Supermarket Intelligence Pipeline -Python · PyTorch · YOLOv8 · DeepSORT · OpenCV · FFmpeg · FastAPI · RAG · React.js · PostgreSQL
Pre-processed a dataset of ~1M images into temporally-aligned video sequences; built real-time customer tracking using YOLOv8 + DeepSORT across CCTV feeds with Gaussian Kernel density heatmaps for product placement analysis.
Integrated LLMs via RAG pipeline to correlate customer movement with POS/sales records; delivered full-stack React.js + Chart.js dashboard for real-time traffic and sales analytics.
TemporalDB - Temporal-Causal Knowledge Engine -FastAPI · PostgreSQL+pgvector · Neo4j · Redi s · Kafka (Redpanda) · Celery · spaCy · Ollama · Next.js · TypeScript · Docker
Designed an event-driven ingestion pipeline enabling natural language queries like 'Why did revenue drop in Q3?' with cited, multi-hop causal answers; implemented a 6-stage NLP pipeline using spaCy and sentence-transformers.
Engineered dual-write persistence layer synchronizing PostgreSQL (pgvector) and Neo4j; built intent-based query engine with fully local LLM-powered synthesis via Ollama (LLaMA 3.1); achieved async-first architecture end-to-end.
AI-Powered Debt Collection Call Analytics Platform -FastAPI · Next.js · TypeScript · LangChain · Ant hropic Claude · SQLAlchemy · Docker
Built a full-stack AI platform processing debt collection transcripts through a 7-stage enrichment pipeline - PII redaction, TCPA/FDCPA compliance detection, intent classification (COMMITTED/CONDITIONAL/EVASIVE), objection extraction, and automated next-action recommendations.
Integrated Anthropic Claude via LangChain for debtor intent classification; built an AI chatbot converting natural language queries to SQL; achieved 99.2% test coverage across 128 tests.
Hindi AI Customer Support & Lead Management Agent -Python · Twilio · Zoho CRM · LLMs
Developed an AI agent that reads and manages leads from Zoho CRM and performs automated follow-up calls via Twilio, conducting natural, context-aware conversations in Hindi to improve customer engagement.
Implemented call-based interest evaluation logic that automatically writes structured responses back to Zoho, enabling a fully automated and intelligent lead management workflow.

FastAPI · GDAL · GeoPandas · PostgreSQL · MinIO · AWS
Designed a deep learning pipeline supporting 5 configurable segmentation architectures (UNet, FPN, DeepLabV3/V3+, UNet++) trained on aerial imagery and Digital Elevation Models for watershed delineation and flow-line detection.
Developed a FastAPI Atlas API orchestrating aerial imagery (MapTiler) and DEM data (OpenTopography/USGS) with intelligent spatial caching via MinIO and PostgreSQL; built a C++ hydraulics engine (Qt/Crow) for storm sewer analysis.
